products.pitch_es: Un árbol de sobremesa formado por dos piezas que se encajan sin herramientas. Se monta en segundos, se guarda plano y preside la mesa o la recepción cada Navidad.
products.pitch_en: A tabletop tree made of two panels that slot together, no tools needed. It assembles in seconds, stores flat and takes pride of place on the desk or at reception every Christmas.
